Key bits if analysis:

# Figure 2: The growth of London's total private rent bill

2006 to 2025, region totals, ONS/MHCLG data

Calculations

```{python}
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "year": [2006, 2011, 2016, 2021, 2025],
    "prs_dwellings": [661779, 872298, 1014230, 1074736, 1121903],
    "rent_nominal": [1216, 1367, 1655, 1735, 2235],
    "cpi_index": [0.5773, 0.6749, 0.7276, 0.8064, 1.0000],
    "hourly_pay": [13.88, 15.84, 16.43, 19.3, 23.69],
})

PAY_2025 = df["hourly_pay"].iloc[-1]  # £23.69 an hour

# Average monthly rent
df["rent_2025"] = df["rent_nominal"] / df["cpi_index"]    # £ at 2025 prices
df["rent_hours"] = df["rent_nominal"] / df["hourly_pay"]  # hours of median-pay work
df["rent_hours_scaled"] = df["rent_hours"] * PAY_2025     # hours restated in 2025 pay

# Total annual rent bill = homes x monthly rent x 12
df["total_nominal"] = df["prs_dwellings"] * df["rent_nominal"] * 12
df["total_2025"] = df["prs_dwellings"] * df["rent_2025"] * 12
df["total_hours"] = df["prs_dwellings"] * df["rent_hours"] * 12

d = df.set_index("year")
x = d["prs_dwellings"]
```

Figure

```{python}
BLUE, PURPLE, SALMON, GREY = "#3A80B3", "#B385D1", "#E88E7F", "0.6"
XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX = 520000, 1220000, 1000, 2600

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7), layout="constrained")
ax.set(xlim=(XMIN, XMAX), ylim=(YMIN, YMAX))

# Isolines: monthly rent × dwellings = k
xs = np.linspace(XMIN, XMAX, 200)
for bn in [10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35]:
    k = bn * 1e9 / 12
    ax.plot(xs, k / xs, color=GREY, lw=0.5, ls="--", zorder=0)
    if k / YMAX >= XMIN:
        # crosses the top edge: label just above the axes
        ax.text(k / YMAX, YMAX, f"£{bn}bn/yr", ha="center", va="bottom", color=GREY, zorder=3)
    else:
        # crosses the left edge: label stays inside
        ax.text(XMIN, k / XMIN, f" £{bn}bn/yr", va="bottom", color=GREY, zorder=3)


# Series: everything that differs between the three lines (totals in £bn)
SERIES = [
    {"col": "rent_nominal", "name": "£ nominal", "color": BLUE,
    "name_dy": 0, "total": "total_nominal", "fmt": "£{:.1f}bn"},
    {"col": "rent_2025", "name": "£ 2025 prices", "color": PURPLE,
    "name_dy": 7, "total": "total_2025", "fmt": "£{:.1f}bn"},
    {"col": "rent_hours_scaled", "name": "median-pay hours", "color": SALMON,
    "name_dy": -5, "total": "total_hours", "fmt": "{:.2f}bn hrs"},
]

# Label displacement from its own dot, per year and series: (dx, dy) in points
LABEL_OFFSETS = {
    2006: {"rent_nominal": (0, -20),"rent_2025": (0, 20), "rent_hours_scaled": (0, -20)},
    2011: {"rent_nominal": (0, -20), "rent_2025": (0, -20), "rent_hours_scaled": (-57, 23)},
    2016: {"rent_nominal": (0, -20), "rent_2025": (-13, -25), "rent_hours_scaled": (0, 20)},
    2021: {"rent_nominal": (0, -20), "rent_2025": (-16, 35), "rent_hours_scaled": (-43, -21)},
    2025: {"rent_nominal": (15, -34), "rent_2025": (15, 34), "rent_hours_scaled": (15, 0)},
}

for s in SERIES:
    ax.plot(x, d[s["col"]], color=s["color"], lw=2.5, zorder=1)
    ax.scatter(x, d[s["col"]], color=s["color"], s=40, edgecolor="white", zorder=2)
    ax.annotate(s["name"], (x[2006], d.loc[2006, s["col"]]), xytext=(-10,
    s["name_dy"]), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", va="center", color=s["color"], zorder=3)

    for year, offsets in LABEL_OFFSETS.items():
        total = s["fmt"].format(d.loc[year, s["total"]] / 1e9) # totals in £bn
        ax.annotate(
            f"{year}\n{total}", (x[year], d.loc[year, s["col"]]),
            xytext=offsets[s["col"]], textcoords="offset points",
            va="center", color=s["color"], zorder=3,
        )

# Axes
ax.set(xlabel="Private rented dwellings in London", ylabel="Average monthly rent")
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v, _: f"{v / 1e6:.1f}m")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter("£{x:,.0f}")

sec = ax.secondary_yaxis("right", functions=(lambda v: v / PAY_2025, lambda v: v * PAY_2025))
sec.set_ylabel("Hours of median-pay work per month's rent", color=SALMON)
sec.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor=SALMON)

# fig.savefig(OUTPUT_DIRECTORY / "figure_01_total_rent_bill.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()
```

data = pd.read_parquet(PROCESSED_DIRECTORY / "greater_london_rents_dataset.parquet")

len(data[

len(data[

# number of private rented dwellings
len(data[data["private_rented_2011"] == True]) # 878 151 private rented in 2011
len(data[data["private_rented_2021"] == True]) # 1,174,022 private rented in 2021

# average estimated vs imputed rent (includes addresses that dont exist in given year)

data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2024"].agg(["mean", "count"])

# average estimated rent (only private rented addresses in given year)
n_2011 = len(data[data["private_rented_2011"]]) # 878,151 private rented in 2011

t_2011 / n_2011 / 12 # average 1,600 pcm

t_2021 / n_2021 / 12 # average 2,007 pcm

## Data prep

```{python}
# spatial
points = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    data,
    geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(data["x_coordinate"], data["y_coordinate"]),
    crs="EPSG:27700",
)
hexagons = gpd.read_file(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "hex-grid-600m" / "hex-grid-600.shp"
    ).to_crs("EPSG:27700")
joined = gpd.sjoin(points, hexagons[["geometry"]], predicate="within")

# to display boundaries
boroughs = gpd.read_file(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "london-boroughs" / "london-boroughs-clipped.gpkg"
    ).to_crs("EPSG:27700")
london = boroughs.union_all()

# rent only counts towards the total for privately rented properties
joined["rent_2011"] = joined["est_rent_2011"].where(joined["private_rented_2011"], 0)
joined["rent_2021"] = joined["est_rent_2021"].where(joined["private_rented_2021"], 0)
joined["rent_2011"].sum() # 16,860,249,333
joined["rent_2021"].sum() # 28,271,600,199

# rent in £ 2025 prices
joined["rent_2011_2025_prices"] = joined["rent_2011"] / 0.6749
joined["rent_2021_2025_prices"] = joined["rent_2021"] / 0.8064
joined["rent_2011_2025_prices"].sum() # 24,981,848,174
joined["rent_2021_2025_prices"].sum() # 35,059,028,025

# hexagon level stats
stats = joined.groupby("index_right").agg(
    n_properties=("uprn", "size"),
    n_private_rented_2011=("private_rented_2011", "sum"),
    n_private_rented_2021=("private_rented_2021", "sum"),
    t_rent_2011=("rent_2011_2025_prices", "sum"),
    t_rent_2021=("rent_2021_2025_prices", "sum"),
)
# average rents
stats["a_rent_2011"] = stats["t_rent_2011"] / stats["n_private_rented_2011"]
stats["a_rent_2021"] = stats["t_rent_2021"] / stats["n_private_rented_2021"]
# change over time
stats["n_private_rented_change_relative"] = (stats["n_private_rented_2021"] / stats["n_private_rented_2011"] - 1)*100
stats["n_private_rented_change_absolute"] = stats["n_private_rented_2021"] - stats["n_private_rented_2011"]
stats["t_rent_change_relative"] = (stats["t_rent_2021"] / stats["t_rent_2011"] - 1)*100
stats["t_rent_change_absolute"] = stats["t_rent_2021"] - stats["t_rent_2011"]
stats["a_rent_change_relative"] = (stats["a_rent_2021"] / stats["a_rent_2011"] - 1)*100
stats["a_rent_change_absolute"] = stats["a_rent_2021"] - stats["a_rent_2011"]

# getting rid of very small denominators 
stats = stats.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
MIN_PRIVATE_RENTED = 20
low_2011 = stats["n_private_rented_2011"] < MIN_PRIVATE_RENTED
stats.loc[low_2011, ["n_private_rented_change_relative", "t_rent_change_relative"]] = np.nan

hexagons = hexagons.join(stats)  # hexagons with no properties get NaN
hexagons = hexagons.clip(london, keep_geom_type=True)

# checks
hexagons['n_properties'].mean() # addresses per hexagon on average
# 350m: 329.3637446403049 
# 600m: 864.3466583385384
# 1075m (15m2): 2536.0134392180817

stats["t_rent_2011"].sum() # 16.9bn / 25.0bn in 2025 prices
plt.figure()
stats["t_rent_2011"].hist(bins=30)
plt.show()

stats["t_rent_2021"].sum() # 28.3bn / 35,1bn in 2025 prices
plt.figure()
stats["t_rent_2021"].hist(bins=30)
plt.show()

```

## Map function

```{python}
def plot_hex_map(
    column,
    formatter,
    vmin=None,
    vmax=None,
    extend="both",
    filename=None,
    cmap=cmc.batlow,
    diverging=False,
    gamma=None,
):
    """Plot a hexagon choropleth with borough outlines and a colour-matched histogram.

    vmin / vmax default to the 2nd / 98th percentile of the column.
    diverging=True keeps a linear scale but crops the (diverging) cmap so that zero
    sits at its neutral midpoint and colour intensity is proportional on both sides.
    gamma applies a power-law colour scale (e.g. 0.5) to spread out skewed data.
    If filename is given, the figure is saved to OUTPUT_DIRECTORY.
    """
    data = hexagons[column].dropna()
    if vmin is None:
        vmin = data.quantile(0.02)
    if vmax is None:
        vmax = data.quantile(0.98)

    if diverging:
        if not vmin < 0 < vmax:
            raise ValueError(f"diverging scale needs vmin < 0 < vmax, got {vmin}, {vmax}")
        vlim = max(abs(vmin), abs(vmax))
        lo = 0.5 + vmin / (2 * vlim)
        hi = 0.5 + vmax / (2 * vlim)
        cmap = ListedColormap(cmap(np.linspace(lo, hi, 256)))
        norm = Normalize(vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)
    elif gamma is not None:
        norm = PowerNorm(gamma=gamma, vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)
    else:
        norm = Normalize(vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))

    # map
    hexagons.drop(data.index).plot(ax=ax, color="#e6e6e6", linewidth=0, zorder=0)
    hexagons.loc[data.index].plot(
        column=column,
        cmap=cmap,
        norm=norm,
        legend=True,
        legend_kwds={"shrink": 0.6, "extend": extend, "format": formatter},
        ax=ax,
    )

    # boroughs
    boroughs.boundary.plot(ax=ax, color="white", linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.8, zorder=3)

    ax.set_axis_off()
    plt.tight_layout()
    fig.canvas.draw()

    # histogram
    cbar_pos = fig.axes[1].get_position()
    width = 0.12
    height = cbar_pos.height * 0.3
    gap = 0.02

    hist_ax = fig.add_axes([cbar_pos.x0 - gap - width, cbar_pos.y0, width, height])
    _n, _bins, patches = hist_ax.hist(data.clip(lower=vmin, upper=vmax), bins=15)

    for patch in patches:
        mid = patch.get_x() + patch.get_width() / 2
        patch.set_facecolor(cmap(norm(mid)))

    hist_ax.set_axis_off()

    if filename:
        fig.savefig(OUTPUT_DIRECTORY / filename, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.show()
```

# Plotting and saving maps

```{python}

mils = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"£{x / 1e6:g}m")
mils_change = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{'-' if x < 0 else '+'}£{abs(x) / 1e6:g}m")
pct_change = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:+g}%")
properties = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:+,.0f}")
rent = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{'-' if x < 0 else '+'}£{abs(x):,.0f}")

# 2011 and 2021 totals
# higher cap plus a square-root colour scale, so the central core is not one saturated block
rent_vmax = max(hexagons[c].dropna().quantile(0.98) for c in ["t_rent_2011", "t_rent_2021"])

plot_hex_map(
    "t_rent_2011",
    mils,
    vmin=0, vmax=rent_vmax, extend="max",
    gamma=0.6,
    filename="map_01_total-rent-2011.png",
)
plot_hex_map(
    "t_rent_2021",
    mils,
    vmin=0, vmax=rent_vmax, extend="max",
    gamma=0.6,
    filename="map_02_total-rent-2021.png",
)

# change in rent totals (absolute)
plot_hex_map(
    "t_rent_change_absolute",
    mils_change,
    filename="map_03_total-rent-change-absolute.png",
)

# change in rent totals (relative)
plot_hex_map(
    "t_rent_change_relative",
    pct_change,
    filename="map_04_total-rent-change-relative.png"
)

# change in number of private rented properties (absolute)
plot_hex_map(
    "n_private_rented_change_absolute",
    properties,
    filename="map_05_number-private-rented-change-absolute.png",
)

# change in number of private rented properties (relative)
plot_hex_map(
    "n_private_rented_change_relative",
    pct_change,
    filename="map_06_number-private-rented-change-relative.png",
)

# change in average rent (absolute)
plot_hex_map(
    "a_rent_change_absolute",
    rent,
    cmap=cmc.roma_r, diverging=True,
    filename="map_07_average-rent-change-absolute.png",
)

# change in average rent (relative)
plot_hex_map(
    "a_rent_change_relative",
    pct_change,
    cmap=cmc.roma_r, diverging=True,
    filename="map_08_average-rent-change-relative.png",
)

```
